endorsements.quote: Third, model accuracy and hallucination prevalence should be assessed before being put into practice, through iterative testing and evaluation.
Furthermore, the scientific adequacy of the LLM’s responses should be assessed with regard to current standards of care and up-to-date guidelines.
Therefore, plug-ins should be evaluated with the same amount of scrutiny as the LLM itself.
First and foremost, understanding the model’s origins, version, training database content, and strengths as well as drawbacks are essential prerequisites for an informed use of the LLM.
Furthermore, in the same way clinicians require continuing education in emerging and evolving health care topics, frequent training will be essential to use LLM-related tools adequately.
A crucial aspect in the deployment and judicious implementation of LLMs in a clinical setting lies in the establishment of a proactive error reporting program.

unlisted_practices: Craft user prompts to LLMs carefully, including a detailed description of the clinical context (history, exam, and current and historical workup data).
Assess LLM response consistency and variability by regenerating responses multiple times using standardized scenarios before clinical use.
Establish a proactive error reporting program for LLM near-miss incidents to inform best practice guidelines and fine-tune local models.

Establish local institutional governance defining patient information and consent methods, accountability for errors, testing and continuous improvement, defined tasks, human final decision, training and certification, and quality control for LLMs.
Develop national legal and regulatory frameworks to guide the use of LLMs in health care.

screen.reason: This is a guidance/perspective article presenting a general technical framework for clinicians and institutions to approach LLMs and mitigate hallucination risks.
